### Indicators

${PLAN_INDICATORS_TABLE}

> Indicators table format:
> | Name | Kind | Source | Baseline (24h) | Threshold | Direction | Scope |
> |------|------|--------|----------------|-----------|-----------|-------|
> | err-rate-checkout | ratio | `metrics-query` `Datadog:query_metrics` `sum:errors{service:checkout}.as_count() / sum:requests{service:checkout}.as_count() by {env}` | staging 0.21% / prod 0.08% | > 5× baseline sustained 5m | unintended-watch | shared |
> | cache-hit-ratio   | ratio | `metrics-query` `Datadog:query_metrics` `sum:cache.hit{...} / (sum:cache.hit{...} + sum:cache.miss{...}) by {env}` | staging 78% / prod 84% | < 90% of baseline | intended-up | shared |
> | error-log-rate-search | ratio | `log-search` `Loki:query` `sum(rate({service="search", level="error"}[5m])) by (env) / sum(rate({service="search"}[5m])) by (env)` | staging 0.4% / prod 0.18% | > 3× baseline sustained 5m | unintended-watch | shared |
> | replication-lag-us-east | gauge | `metrics-query` `CloudWatch` `AWS/RDS ReplicaLag dimensions=[{DBInstance: db-prod-us-east}]` | 0.4s p95 | > 5s sustained 2m | unintended-watch | per-env: prod-us-east-1 |
> | home-page-up | gauge | `shell` `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://example.com/` | 200 | != 200 sustained 60s | unintended-watch | shared |
> | edge-cache-build-id | gauge | `shell` `curl -fsS https://example.com/api/version \| jq -r .build_sha` | (n/a — first deploy) | == "<merge_sha>" by +5m post-deploy | intended-up | shared |
>
> The Source column carries two pieces:
> - **Source kind** in backticks: `metrics-query` (any structured query language — Datadog, PromQL, APL, TraceQL, LogQL), `log-search` (log query specifically), or `shell` (an arbitrary shell command, used for HTTP probes and content checks).
> - **Source body**: for `metrics-query` / `log-search`, the `Server:tool_name` MCP reference followed by the query string. For `shell`, the literal command. The executor parses the kind first, then dispatches to the appropriate source handler.
